the design of Six Sigma programs, electronic-business practices, and SCA are moderated by the technological intensity of the firm.

(1) the level of technological investment of a firm moderates the relationships among Six-Sigma program design factors and applications for electronic-business, and (2) sustainable competitive advantage.
Six Sigma program design and e-business applications are positively related to competitive advantage for high-tech organizations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the moderating effect that technological intensity has on the relationships among six sigma program design factors, electronic-business practices, and SCA.

how technological intensity moderates the relationships among SixSigma program design, electronic-business applications, and sustainable competitive advantage for manufacturing and service organizations.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the relationships among SixSigma design, electronic-business practices, and competitive advantage differ among high and low technological intensity firms.
Six Sigma program design and e-business applications are more important to the SCA of high technological intensity firms, than for low technological intensity firms.
the implementation of Six Sigma program design and applications of e-business to the Six Sigma program is dependent upon the level of technological intensiveness of the firm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Six Sigma programs can have a positive impact on the SCA of firms that are technologically intensive and that have applications to electronic-business practices.
Six Sigma programs must be tailored for the technological intensity of the firm.
Six Sigma programs must be designed and applied to electronic business in a manner that considers the level of technology intensity of the firm to achieve sustainable competitive advantage.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Six Sigma programs should be designed differently in high-tech and low-tech companies.
high-tech companies should emphasize Six Sigma program design and electronic-business applications for Six Sigma to achieve competitive advantage.
Six Sigma programs are not one size fits all.
